name: v4_end_frame
prompt:
Edit only the medals and ribbons on the surface: the three separate Olympic medals
are now fully melted and mixed into one perfectly uniform puddle of deep teal metallic paint.
Rich dark teal-green with a lustrous metallic sheen and scattered gold shimmer particles,
tiny bright golden sparkles catching the light across the surface.
No traces of individual medals, no ribbons, no gold or silver or bronze areas remaining.
One smooth continuous puddle of deep teal paint with gold glitter highlights.
The palette knife is resting flat in the paint puddle, hand still holding it.
Everything else unchanged — same dark surface, same hand position, same lighting, same camera angle.
